title: Main Street Mornington Festival 2026
summary: Annual free street festival on Mornington's Main Street: 7 stages, live music, local wine and craft beer, food stalls, artisan crafts, kids' activities, roving performers, 11am to 5pm on the third Sunday of October. 2026 contingent on sponsorship after 2025 was cancelled.
suitableFor: All ages; families; locals; day-trippers; tourists
accessibilityNotes: Street event: flat Main Street terrain; pram-friendly; contact organiser for accessibility details
nearbyAttractions: Mornington Pier; Port Phillip Bay; Mornington Racecourse; local galleries
suggestedItineraryPairing: Full day out, pair a market morning in Mornington with the festival when dates align, then stay on for the foreshore and dinner.
editorVerdict: If it runs, it's the year's biggest Main Street day. 2025 was cancelled. Check the organiser before you plan around it.
editorNote:
Main Street Mornington Festival is the annual third-Sunday-of-October street takeover: 7 stages, live music, local wine and craft beer, food stalls and roving performers from 11am to 5pm. When it lands, it's the biggest single day Main Street sees all year.

The complication: 2025 was cancelled when the funding gap couldn't be closed, and the official site (as of late 2025) listed 2026 as 'seeking sponsors'. VicFomo and OnlyMelbourne project 18 October 2026 based on the annual pattern, but treat it as unconfirmed until the organiser announces.

If you're planning travel around it, contact the Northern Mornington Peninsula Tourism Association before you book. We'll update this entry as the status firms up.
